description: Current total value locked (TVL, USD) of one DeFi protocol from DefiLlama, by protocol slug (e.g. aave, uniswap-v3). Returns the single current TVL number only; chain breakdown and history are not included. Choose this tool for: Current total value locked of one DeFi protocol. Close alternatives on this server: crypto_defillama_yields (DeFi pool APY, TVL, 7/30-day APY change); finance_dia_crypto_oracle (DIA crypto price oracle: current USD price for one asset). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
